title: C: __ASSERT_NO_MSG() gives no diagnostic on crash
description: Runtime assertions in meshcore/adapter.c, lora_l2_tx.c, and others use __ASSERT_NO_MSG() which crashes the node with only a file:line but no explanation of the violated condition. An AI monitoring fleet logs sees '*** ASSERTION FAIL @ file:line' with no cause. Fix: upgrade to __ASSERT(cond, "reason") or replace with LOG_ERR + return -EINVAL for recoverable cases. Example: __ASSERT_NO_MSG(\!k_is_in_isr()) at lora_l2_tx.c:514 should say why ISR context is forbidden.
